title: How to Get Rid of Vexes?
summary: Ways to remove vexes summoned by evokers, including the Vexxed plugin and other methods.

body.text: Vexes are small flying hostile mobs summoned by Evokers. They're notorious for dealing high damage, passing through blocks, and swarming players. Here are reliable ways to deal with them.

For Spigot/Paper servers, the [Vexxed](https://www.spigotmc.org/resources/vexxed.121205/) plugin by AvatarKage automatically removes all vexes summoned by a specific Evoker when that Evoker is defeated. This is perfect for raids and Woodland Mansions where you don't want to deal with lingering vexes.

items: Place the .jar in your server's plugins/ folder
Defeat Evokers as normal - all of their vexes will be removed automatically
Kill them directly - Vexes have 14 HP and can be killed with any weapon, though their mobility makes them tricky.
Use area damage - Splash potions, TNT, or other AoE effects can clear groups faster.
Build defensively - Since vexes phase through blocks, walls won't stop them. Focus on mobility and crowd control.
Remove the Evoker source - Vexes are summoned by Evokers and will remain until killed or the world is reloaded in some edge cases. Killing the Evoker doesn't immediately despawn vexes in vanilla.

body.text: In vanilla Minecraft, killing the Evoker does not remove its vexes - you must kill them separately. Plugins like Vexxed solve this quality-of-life issue by clearing them on Evoker death.
